tool_model: Proposed: BERT-BiLSTM-EAA (using MacBERT pre-trained model). Baselines: SVM, LR, TextCNN, BiLSTM-Attention, BERT-BiLSTM-MLP, BERT-BiLSTM-Attention, BERT-EAA-BiLSTM.
empirical_results: BERT-BiLSTM-EAA (Proposed): Accuracy = 93.98%, Precision = 87.36%, Recall = 84.32%, F1 = 85.18%. BERT-EAA-BiLSTM (Best Baseline): Accuracy = 93.62%, Precision = 86.89%, Recall = 81.61%, F1 = 83.92%. SVM (Worst Baseline): Accuracy = 28.19%, F1 = 3.14%
limitations: The current model lacks external knowledge to enhance scam recognition in specific domains (e.g., pension or medical fraud). Additionally, it only processes plain text and lacks multi-modal capabilities to handle scam messages containing images.
